fusions.name: Stooping Snatch
fusions.desc: Jets down on an enemy up to 8 tiles away and snatches it in your arms for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. The target moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped on the Rocks
fusions.desc: Carries the target up and drops it on the rocks for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Siphon Glide
fusions.desc: Jets you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Skims the Surface

riders.text: you jet over it faster than over ground
and gliding on it rests you
and anything that has to wade cannot reach you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your stamina recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
